source_name: Є-data public finance platform (edata.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Umbrella entry point of the Ministry of Finance open-finance ecosystem; points to spending.gov.ua, data.gov.ua and related datasets, useful for discovering additional contract/financial-report datasets relevant to banking-technology suppliers.

source_name: Держспецзв'язку (cip.gov.ua) — independent information-security audit of critical infrastructure: auditor requirements and register
why_relevant: Defines attestation requirements for information-security auditors and maintains a Перелік (register) of attested auditors entitled to audit critical infrastructure operators, which includes banks and payment infrastructure — a named-entity list of the assurance supplier population.

source_name: Regulation.gov.ua — каталог державних функцій та дозволів (ведення реєстру платіжних систем)
why_relevant: The state deregulation catalogue documents, function by function, which body maintains which register and under which legal act — here explicitly 'веде реєстр платіжних систем, систем розрахунків, учасників цих систем та операторів послуг платіжної інфраструктури'. It is a meta-source for verifying WHICH register is legally authoritative for a given actor class and for detecting when a register is merged, renamed or abolished — a recurring problem in UA (e.g. the 2020 split, the 2024 transfer of the ДРФУ functions).

source_name: Каталог фінтех-компаній України 2023 (MFA-hosted mirror)
why_relevant: Prior-year edition of the same catalog, hosted on a Ukrainian MFA domain (stable, non-bot-defended). Valuable for time-series: comparing 2023 vs 2025 rosters shows which fintechs exited, merged or entered — a cheap proxy for market churn and competitive dynamics.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — Члени (EMA member directory)
why_relevant: Single richest structured roster of Ukrainian payments actors: international schemes (Visa, Mastercard), ~35 banks, PSPs/fintechs (Platon, NovaPay, EasyPay, iPay.ua, Rozetka Pay, PayForce, Payoneer, FinExpress), plus hardware/services vendors including Printec and GD Next GmbH, and Moldovan banks (Victoria Bank, MAIB). Each logo is an outbound link to the member entity, so the page snowballs into dozens of vendor and competitor domains.

source_name: YouControl — page listing its 220+ underlying data sources
why_relevant: A published inventory of the Ukrainian registries and datasets that aggregators consume. Effectively a ready-made map of upstream primary sources for the whole workstream — use it to discover registries this cell has not yet covered.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — Партнери (EMA partners page)
why_relevant: Maps EMA's institutional network: NBU, Cyber Police, SBU, State Financial Monitoring, plus international bodies (Europol EC3, EAST, Open Banking Europe, Berlin Group), peer associations (АУБ, credit-union and insurance associations), commercial partners (RBR, GD Next, TransferGo, Konsentus, FS Group, Front-U) and payments media (PaySpace Magazine, Fintech Insider, Finance.ua). A one-page partnership graph and a jump-off point to further pointer sources.

source_name: Радник у сфері публічних закупівель — каталог судових та інших реєстрів
why_relevant: Practitioner portal for Ukrainian procurement professionals that maintains curated tool/registry catalogues and republishes Clarity Project analyses. Its taxonomies enumerate further registries and analytical services relevant to contract tracing.

source_name: LiveBusiness UA — internet acquiring service catalogue
why_relevant: Maintained directory/ranking of Ukrainian internet-acquiring and payment-acceptance services — a compact enumeration of the competitive set including smaller players that do not surface in press coverage.

source_name: Bank award-page aggregations on vendor/bank sites (e.g. OTP Bank «Нагороди банку, премії та номінації», NovaPay awards posts)
why_relevant: Banks and PSPs maintain running award pages that back-fill shortlist/winner history when the award organiser's own archive is thin or has rotated URLs. They also state the exact nomination wording, which is often the only public description of the underlying deployment.

source_name: NAAU — National Accreditation Agency of Ukraine, register of accredited testing laboratories and certification bodies
why_relevant: Publishes the register of ISO/IEC 17025 testing laboratories and 17021/17065 certification bodies in Ukraine — the route to identifying labs that could test terminal/POS hardware and bodies certifying ISMS for financial institutions.

source_name: Асоціація "IT Ukraine" — Члени Асоціації / Members
why_relevant: 72 member IT companies plus strategic partnerships with 9 regional IT clusters. Ukrainian IT service firms are the integrators and software suppliers behind bank digital projects and are direct or partner-channel competitors for systems-integration work. English mirror available at /en/members/, easing entity matching.

source_name: Асоціація підприємств інформаційних технологій України (АПІТУ) — Члени Асоціації
why_relevant: APITU is the hardware/IT-equipment side of the Ukrainian IT industry (distributors, systems integrators, equipment suppliers) as opposed to IT Ukraine's outsourcing-services membership. This is the association most likely to contain self-service terminal, kiosk and POS hardware channel partners — the closest analogue to an ATM/hardware industry body found in this pass.

source_name: EU4Business in Ukraine — programme and project directory
why_relevant: Ukrainian-language hub listing 40+ EU-funded SME/access-to-finance projects with implementing partners (GIZ, EBRD, banks). Pointer to the partner banks and implementing agencies that then run their own supplier procurement.

source_name: Українська Рада Бізнесу — перелік учасників (UBC member list)
why_relevant: Umbrella body whose members are themselves associations and business unions. Useful as a meta-pointer: it enumerates the Ukrainian association landscape in one place, letting this cell discover sectoral bodies (payments, retail, IT, cash handling) that do not surface in topic-keyword search.

source_name: Асоціація українських банків (АУБ) — Члени АУБ / AUB members
why_relevant: Ukraine's oldest banking association (founded 1990), with 70+ member organisations spanning commercial banks, state banks and non-bank financial companies. The non-bank members are the interesting part for vendor discovery. An English mirror of the member list exists, making cross-language entity matching easier. AUB is also named as an EMA partner, confirming the association network.

entity_name: Українська асоціація фінтех та інноваційних компаній
source_name: Українська асоціація фінтех та інноваційних компаній (UAFIC) — Мембери
why_relevant: Member club of Ukraine's fintech association: reported member mix ~66% fintech, 14% IT companies, 14% MFOs, 6% banks. Direct roster of PSPs, lending platforms, insurtech and data companies that rarely surface in bank press releases. Complements EMA (bank/scheme-heavy) with a startup/vendor-heavy view.

entity_name: Українська асоціація фінтех та інноваційних компаній
source_name: UAFIC — Ukrainian Association of Fintech and Innovative Companies, news & annual catalogue
why_relevant: Industry body whose annual fintech company catalogue (produced with NBU, Ministry of Digital Transformation and IFC support) is effectively a ready-made actor map of ~260 Ukrainian fintech firms, and whose news page announces memoranda and partnerships. Strongest single pointer for expanding the vendor/competitor list feeding the media monitoring.

source_name: DOU.ua company profiles (jobs.dou.ua) as a media/vendor cross-reference
why_relevant: Ukrainian IT-community platform hosting company profiles and reviews for both the trade outlets and the fintech vendors they cover; hiring activity and stack descriptions are an indirect signal of which vendors are actually delivering bank projects.

source_name: Infobox Prozorro — official knowledge base
why_relevant: Operator-maintained explainer base covering how to search tenders, how monitoring works, and how the analytics modules behave. Best single source for correctly interpreting procedure types, statuses and award terminology before building a collection pipeline.

source_name: Wikipedia (uk) — ПРОСТІР (платіжна система) and Український процесінговий центр
why_relevant: Cheap actor-map bootstrap: year-by-year list of banks that joined PROSTIR, card-in-circulation figures, and a footnote trail back to NBU primary documents. Use strictly as a pointer, never as a cited fact.

source_name: IFC Ukraine country programme page (ERA / $2bn package)
why_relevant: Pointer to the shape of IFC's Ukraine pipeline, including the Economic Resilience Action programme and its stated pivot toward digital infrastructure — useful for anticipating which advisory disclosures will appear next.

source_name: PCI SSC — Approved Scanning Vendor (ASV) / PIN / P2PE / 3DS assessor listings
why_relevant: Beyond QSA, the ASV, PCI PIN, P2PE and 3DS assessor and validated-product listings expose which security firms and which certified hardware/software components (HSMs, PIN entry devices, P2PE solutions) are in scope for Ukrainian acquirers and processors.

source_name: PCI SSC — Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) company directory
why_relevant: Authoritative global listing of QSA companies filterable by market served; the canonical way to enumerate which assessor firms are entitled to audit Ukrainian banks, PSPs and processors, and which local firms hold QSA status.

source_name: Національна/Незалежна асоціація банків України (НАБУ) — Банки-учасники
why_relevant: Roster of NABU member banks — historically >95% of Ukrainian banking-system assets. The canonical demand-side actor list for anyone selling into Ukrainian banks; also the base for identifying which banks are NOT members. NABU additionally lists associate members and partners (e.g. it carries a page for the Ukrainian fintech association), which extends the pointer into non-bank vendors.

source_name: ApiX-Drive integration catalogue (Ukrainian PSP connectors)
why_relevant: Third-party iPaaS listing hundreds of connectors per PSP (WayForPay, LiqPay, Fondy). The connector lists are a machine-readable map of which CRMs, CMSs and SaaS tools sit around each Ukrainian gateway — i.e. the de-facto partner ecosystem.

source_name: AppsRunTheWorld — customer databases by product (e.g. NCR Atleos ATM as a Service)
why_relevant: Commercial database that enumerates named customers per enterprise software product, including geography. Fast way to test whether a vendor has disclosed Ukrainian installations without reading every case study.

source_name: ATMIA showroom — vendor profiles
why_relevant: Industry-association vendor showroom listing self-service suppliers and their materials; a stable pointer for enumerating the vendor universe (including smaller software vendors) before hunting country references.

source_name: ensun payment-gateway company index (Ukraine)
why_relevant: Aggregated English-language index claiming ~37 Ukrainian payment-gateway companies — useful purely for enumerating long-tail names to verify elsewhere; the underlying data quality of such aggregators is unverified.

source_name: Enterprise Europe Network — partnering opportunities (Ukrainian fintech profiles)
why_relevant: EU-run B2B partnering database where Ukrainian fintech and banking-software firms self-file capability profiles in English to attract partners. An unusual, low-noise register of who is actively seeking European channel partners — revealing capability claims and target segments that never appear in press coverage.

source_name: EuroShop (Düsseldorf) exhibitor directory — UA exhibitors and UA-relevant self-service vendors
why_relevant: The world's largest retail-technology fair; UA manufacturer Modern Expo took the largest single stand (1,600 sqm) among 1,800 exhibitors at EuroShop 2026, showing self-checkout, modular store and parcel-locker lines. The exhibitor directory is an offshore pointer that reveals UA vendors' product roadmaps and their international competitor set in self-service and cash/retail automation.

source_name: FeaturedCustomers — vendor customer-reference profiles
why_relevant: Indexes hundreds of vendor customer references and testimonials per vendor (Finastra profile alone lists 419), including links back to original case studies. Useful for enumerating a vendor's disclosed client base and spotting CEE/UA names quickly.

source_name: Megatrade partner locator ('де купити')
why_relevant: Ukrainian IT/AV distributor's reseller-locator listing named integrator partners (IT-Integrator among them). Distributor partner-locator pages are a reliable, under-used way to enumerate the integrator population and the brands each one carries.

source_name: TAdviser — product and vendor project registries (Way4, BPC Group)
why_relevant: Wiki-style registry of vendor products and implementation projects across the post-Soviet space; retains historical BPC/SmartVista and Way4 project records including Ukrainian offices and deployments that vendors have since de-emphasised. Useful for pre-2022 baseline; treat as unverified and cross-check.

entity_name: Telegram vacancy channels for UA IT/fintech
source_name: Telegram vacancy channels for UA IT/fintech (via tgstat career directory)
why_relevant: A large share of Ukrainian IT and fintech vacancies circulate first (and sometimes only) in Telegram channels, often with fuller stack detail than the sanitised board version, and hours-to-days earlier. tgstat's career directory is the discovery layer for which channels to subscribe to.

source_name: Банк Конкорд (Concord Bank) — historical corporate site and news archive
why_relevant: Concord was an early technology-forward small bank (first among small/medium UA banks to be principal member of Mastercard, Visa and PROSTIR; fintech-sponsor/BaaS role). NOTE: the DGF completed its liquidation on 05.05.2026 — value is now historical/archival for vendor-relationship mapping and for tracking where its fintech clients migrated.
